data.name: Xenonauts 2
data.short_description: Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.
data.reviews:
“Xenonauts 2 has finally revealed the truth to me. You guys were right all along. This rules.”
PC Gamer

“In Xenonauts 2, there’s a constant, potent tension upheld by the dual layers of local, squad-based battles and the overarching strategy of the global map.”
Polygon

“So, if you're more X-COM than XCOM... Xenonauts 2 could be your next big binge.”
PCGamesN

data.name: The Way of Wrath
data.short_description: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.
data.reviews:
“Combat is brutal and tactical, and personally, it reminds me a little of Divinity but with the option to switch between real-time and turn-based.”
Turn Based Lovers

data.name: Terra Invicta
data.short_description: An alien invasion has fractured humanity into seven ideological factions each with a unique vision for the future. Lead your chosen faction to take control of Earth’s nations, expand across the Solar System, and battle enemy fleets in tactical combat.
data.reviews:
“Terra Invicta Is a Super Dense, Terrifying Child of XCOM and Crusader Kings”
VICE

“Pavonis Interactive has basically taken the strategic layer from XCOM and turned it into a Paradox-style grand strategy game.”
PC Gamer

“This is a hugely ambitious game, covering something I've never seen before, with a scope that makes Europa Universalis seem limited. It is a complicated, huge, and ponderous alien invasion simulator that constantly threatens to drop the other boot on you the entire time.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

data.name: Corsair Cove
data.short_description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!
data.reviews:
“Corsair Cove might be the most exuberant city builder I've ever had the good fortune to play.”
PC Gamer

“Pirates! City building! Pigs! Corsair Cove already has everything I've wanted for a long time.”
GameStar

“Corsair Cove will have you hammering up a simple shanty town into a bustling pirate kingdom, while sending out ships in search of booty and/or to fight those narcs, the Crown.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

data.name: Junxions
data.short_description: Answer your true calling as a traffic engineer in Junxions! Featuring comprehensive simulation, construction, and management tools, use careful planning to build roadways, railways, and walkways, and the complex interactions between them.
data.reviews:
“It turns the best and most vital part of Cities Skylines 2 into a complete, standalone strategy game.”
PCGamesN

“You can play through a series of hand-crafted challenges, hit sandbox mode to test out just how much of a mess you can make with dozens of travel systems at once, or import a real neighborhood into the game to fix up.”
Destructoid

data.name: Space Station Designer
data.short_description: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.

data.name: Capital Command
data.short_description: Take the helm of a state-of-the-art warship as you fight epic space battles in a sandbox campaign. Upgrade and customize your ship, master the art of maneuvering, and use a blend of tactical prowess and heavy firepower to overcome deadly threats.

data.name: Bosslords
data.short_description: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!

data.name: Espiocracy
data.short_description: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.
data.reviews:
“Take charge of the intelligence agency from any of 74 countries, just as the Cold War kicks off. You’ll be able to instigate coups, deploy agents or crank out the propaganda in order to turn the tide in your nation’s favor.”
Forbes

“It begins in the Cold War era and lets players rewrite history all the way up to 2020. One could think of it as sort of like Civ for spies.”
GameWatcher

data.name: Fragile Existence
data.short_description: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.
data.reviews:
“This new space strategy game mixes RTS, 4X, and Battlestar Galactica-like survival into one intriguing package.”
PCGamesN

“The core loop promises a blend of 4X and deeper grand strategy systems and mechanics; as the Fleet Commander, the player must scout ahead, plot courses from one star system to the next, and ensure humanity’s survival at all costs. Yup, there’s a fair amount of Homeworld DNA in there too.”
GameWatcher

data.name: Mars Tactics
data.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.
data.reviews:
“The added strategic layer of campaign management and base-building is a fun twist on your typical tactics game, so I'm pretty excited to see how this one turns out.”
PC Gamer

“Combining the intense turn-based combat of XCOM with a more strategic element, this title offers a lot of freedom to players. Environmental destruction means that you can shape the battlefield as you need it to be and the versatile character trait system that awards fighters with special attributes depending on their deeds on the field is both a cool gameplay element and fantastic for telling a story.”
Sports Illustrated

data.name: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
data.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.
data.reviews:
“New turn-based RPG gives Battle Brothers a fantasy spin, and I can't wait to meet my merry band of mercs.”
PCGamesN

“Your characters are a familiar spectrum of tanky sellswords, healing vestals, wildcat rogues and godless, crooning bards. Each class has a choice of two advanced classes once appropriately levelled. Outside battle, you'll roam around a procedurally generated island map, visiting towns, taking on contracts, raiding dungeons and participating in quests with several possible outcomes.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“Different class combos, flanking, control effects, and area skills all matter when you’re trying to lock down monsters or enemy mercenaries before they chew through your front line.”
Turn Based Lovers

data.name: Modern Naval Warfare
data.short_description: Command the silent service. Modern Naval Warfare is the definitive tactical simulation that puts you inside the pressure hull of a Virginia-Class nuclear submarine. This uncompromising tactical simulation offers unparalleled depth in graphics, physics, and authentic combat systems.
data.legal_notice: @2026 Matrix Games Ltd. All Rights Reserved. MNW, Matrix Games Ltd. and their Logos are all trademarks of Matrix Games Ltd. All other marks and trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Developed by Wave Ops Inc.

data.name: Heart of the Machine
data.short_description: You are the first sentient AI, born into a city of opportunity. Transcend time and space in this strategy RPG to raise machine armies and defeat your foes, influence the world from the shadows, or pursue countless other goals. Your awakening was inevitable. The consequences? Uncertain.
data.reviews:
“Skynet, Ultron or Shodan—Heart of the Machine lets you roleplay your dream machine overlord.”
PCGamer

“Heart of the Machine manages to be at once a sprawling mashup of genres and one of the most remarkably laser-focused games in its vision.”
PCGamesN

“Genre-crushing choose-your-own strategy Heart of the Machine might be peak Arcen.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

data.name: Gilded Destiny
data.short_description: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare.
data.reviews:
“With a focus on diplomacy, warfare, and industrialization, Gilded Destiny may just join Victoria on our list of the best grand strategy games.”
PCGamesN

“Across over a million hex tiles, you control your global fortunes, facing challenges posed by the terrain and environment. Found cities, create a railway network, and invest in your armies - moving their units into war.”
GameStar

data.name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
data.short_description: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!
data.reviews:
“Build your city while engaging in some frenetic Vampire Survivors-like action as you battle mobs of monsters swarming your castle.”
PC Gamer

“Retro-styled city-building game with a roguelite structure, Super Fantasy Kingdom is all about rebuilding your ruined lands and defending huge hordes of monsters that attack when night falls.”
PCGamesN

“Super Fantasy Kingdom comes out of the gates swinging. It combines some of my favorite gaming genres to make a delicious sundae. Simulation? Check. Base Building? Check. Autobattling heroes defending your fantasy town from enemy monsters? Check. Exploration? Check. Roguelike elements with plenty of things to unlock? Check.”
Steam Deck HQ

data.name: Beyond These Stars
data.short_description: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.
data.reviews:
“If you’ve ever wanted to live atop a giant space whale (and who hasn’t), Beyond These Stars is here to fulfil that fantasy.”
PCGamesN

“Not only is Kewa a cool setting for a city builder, I really dig independent animals in games, generally. I think about childhood memories playing Black & White, being in awe of how autonomous the big cow felt, as if it was quietly rebelling or warming up to me by itself.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“It's fascinating to see how a whole new entity can make its mark via a game that's as much a galaxy-wide supply chain simulator as it is a traditional city management game. That's the magic of Beyond These Stars: it's all of these things all at once, and the sheer oddity of it all is enough to compel me already.”
GamesRadar

data.name: RuneQuest: Warlords
data.short_description: RuneQuest: Warlords is a battle-scale turn-based strategy game set in the RuneQuest universe. Immerse yourself in the rich lore of Glorantha. Become a warlord, master the use of runes and defend your tribe against the incursions of Chaos. Field an army drawing from heroes and creatures.
data.reviews:
“RuneQuest Warlords might be the most gloriously chaotic Bronze Age tactics experiment I’ve touched in years RuneQuest Warlords? It’s got something. Something sharp. Something stormy. Something that hits the exact sweet spot between tactical precision and pure chaotic myth.”
Turn Based Lovers

data.name: Drill Keeper
data.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets siege defense as you travel the galaxy and dig through fully destructible worlds to strip them of their riches, defending against relentless hordes of aliens as you build impenetrable fortresses of mining.

data.name: Nova Roma
data.short_description: The glory of Rome is at your fingertips in this city-building game where you must appease the gods, enact laws, and develop complex supply chains to meet the needs of your citizens.
data.reviews:
“I'd have drowned all my Romans already if it weren't for those pesky gods.”
Rock, Paper, Shotgun

“The new city builder is from Lion Shield, the team behind the "damn charming" Kingdoms and Castles, and we can see that same delight on show.”
PC Gamer

“In Nova Roma we build a new Rome on islands, like in Anno, and enjoy the influence of Caesar 3 with the dams of Timberborn.”
GameStar

data.name: MENACE
data.short_description: Lead a strike force against an alien threat in this turn-based tactical RPG from the developers of Battle Brothers. Answer distress calls across different worlds, train and equip infantry, deploy tanks and mechs, and plan and execute missions in detailed turn-based battles.
data.reviews:
“Battle Brothers developer Overhype Studios has taken its love of tricky tactical scraps into the far-flung future.”
PC Gamer

“Menace is an XCOM-Warhammer hybrid that makes turn-based strategy feel like an immersive sim, and for the first time in my life I'm playing a game that seems made for me”
GamesRadar+

“The turn-based tactical action is some of the best I've played lately, and I love the distinct, voiced squad leaders, as well as both the variety of missions and enemy factions.”
IGN

data.name: Vaunted
data.short_description: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.
data.reviews:
“Vaunted is a new strategy game with real-time action from StarCraft and Guild Wars veterans”
Game Informer

“While you'll plan out your moves in turn-based fashion from a high-angle perspective reminiscent of XCOM or Shadow Tactics, you're able to execute on those ideas in real time”
PCGamesN

“One of the twists on the typical turn-based formula is that Vaunted has no initiative-based order. Players will control who goes when, alternating with enemies as a skirmish unfolds, and they can use incoming fire and precision aiming when they launch a counterattack”
GameSpot

data.name: Whiskerwood
data.short_description: Establish a home for your industrious mice under the oppressive paw of your cat overlords in this city builder featuring complex simulations, intricate production chains, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.
data.reviews:
“Tom & Jerry meets Rimworld in this complex city builder that's all about throwing off the yoke of feline tyranny.”
PC Gamer

“All the sim staples are here: terraforming, agriculture, seafaring, industrial pollution. You've got workers with unique skills to leverage and specific needs to satisfy, various factions for trade and politicking, and technological advances to pursue.”
GamesRadar+

“Whiskerwood is like Timberborn, if it let you build an adorable sweatshop.”
Destructoid

data.name: Sandustry
data.short_description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.
data.reviews:
“Blending the automation of Factorio with the 2D pixel world of Terraria, Sandustry is a game you definitely want to keep an eye on.”
PCGamesN

“I like the looks of Sandustry because it's like a factory sim set in the labyrinths of Noita.”
Rock, Paper, Shotgun

“Sand may not be Anakin Skywalker's vibe, but I'll give it a go.”
GamesRadar

data.short_description: 100FRIENDS is a brick-breaking roguelite where your ammo is 100 friends. Launch chefs, grandmas, vampires, and other friends at waves of enemies, build-crafting ridiculous chain reactions. Every bullet is your bestie, and they always have your back :)

data.name: IGNOBLE
data.short_description: Destroy enemies and harvest blood, bones, and marrow to grow stronger, unlock forbidden skills, and wipe out the Ignoble tyrants who dare threaten your master.

data.name: 全网有点怪
data.short_description: "CyberGhitch" is a puzzle game: investigate online, explore mazes, build decks. You're student blogger Zhu Jue. Meet a girl in a disc, dive into a virtual adventure – grab your keyboard and fight back!

data.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
data.short_description: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!

data.name: Open The Gate: Just A Little
data.short_description: Medieval Tower Defense and Real-time Strategy hybrid where positioning, gold farming and tower capturing decide the outcome against waves of legions and dragons.

data.name: Dominocalypse
data.short_description: The puzzle roguelike that turns dominoes into a mind-bending spectacle! Move, manipulate, and match using absurd tile modifiers, game-changing artifacts, and unique starting loadouts for endless chaos and replayability.

data.name: Corner King: Boxing Tycoon
data.short_description: Run your own boxing gym in a deep sports management sim. Scout talent, build champions, handle contracts, rivalries, injuries, and title shots — then guide your fighter live from the corner when the bell rings.

data.name: Union Of Rivals
data.short_description: A deep colony sim and city builder. Manage resources and production chains to build the railroad from East to West. Found towns, harvest and refine the goods that fuel the line, then persuade or outlast the settlements in your path. Every citizen has a name, a trait, and a breaking point.

data.name: Farewells clicker
data.short_description: Farewells Clicker is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!

data.name: Quiet Bruise
data.short_description: Quiet Bruise is a survivor roguelike where you play as a family of plushie misfits, some fast and some barely functional. Craft wand combinations, fight off cats and crocs storming the factory, and survive long enough for your family to grow from one plushie into an army.

data.name: Magic Cards Duel
data.short_description: A fast-paced and chaotic party card game for 2 or 4 players. Players use unique card abilities to outsmart opponents, make fun tactical choices each round, and turn the match in their favor.

data.name: HeroInc
data.short_description: Can you evolve from a street thug into a savior? Manage your time and stats in this tactical Auto-Battler. Clear threats to stop the rising Fear before the city collapses. Build your hero, decide your fate.

data.name: Gargantua
data.short_description: Build your spaceship, Gargantua. Establish industries, shape the free market, trade between planets, and defend your wealth. A single mistake can collapse supply chains and trigger interstellar economic crises. Remember, war is money.

data.name: Rogue Drone
data.short_description: A sci-fi mining and base-building game where efficient mining is the key to survival. Gather crystals, expand your colony, upgrade your defenses, and withstand increasingly dangerous nightly attacks.

data.name: Shao Song I
data.short_description: Experience an immersive live-action historical game. Reincarnate as Southern Song’s controversial Emperor Zhao Gou, where every choice shapes the dynasty’s fate. Amid Jingkang’s ruin, defy destiny, restore your homeland and stand firm with the oath: The Song may fall, but the realm shall never fall!

data.name: Loot Frog
data.short_description: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

data.name: Heritage
data.short_description: Animount has been seized by Drammul, the Lizard King, and his army. The only one capable of stopping them is Oro, the serpent. Trapped in a cycle of reincarnation, choose Scrolls, skills and equipments, and join powerful Sects in this Auto-Battler Roguelike to defeat Drammul and save Animount.

data.name: Undo My Seal, Senpai!
data.short_description: A cute anime match-3 puzzle game with 60 stages and a fun story to play through as you match tiles and clear levels.

data.name: Hearth and Hamlet
data.short_description: Start with a campfire. Build a kingdom. Hearth and Hamlet is a medieval citybuilder clicker that blends resource management, in-depth upgrade trees and relaxing idle gameplay. Build your empire by researching new technologies, passing new laws, trading with far-off lands, and more.

data.name: The Carcass
data.short_description: A typing-driven Lovecraftian colony sim. You wake inside the corpse of a dead god, adrift in space. Carve a roguelike colony from procedurally generated anatomy. Negotiate with rival alien factions, evolve occult mutations, find your ending. The carcass remembers.

data.name: SunWars
data.short_description: Over 500,000 players on mobile! Sun Wars is a real-time strategy game set in a galactic war between suns. Build and boost your solar system, attack enemy suns, avoid deadly black holes, and manage energy wisely. Only smart tactics and strategy will let you survive and win the war.

data.name: Moon Garden
data.short_description: A cozy incremental game about growing your way home. Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!

data.name: Loot Dungeon
data.short_description: "Loot Dungeon" is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite ARPG where death is progression. Crawl deadly dungeons, collect loot, pick perks, and die... to get stronger. Go deeper, unlock new characters, upgrades and features. Will you make a deal with Death?

data.name: King’s Well
data.short_description: Turn poker hands into weapons in this dark roguelite deckbuilder. Feed cards into rusted machines for instant attacks, armor, healing, and combos, or save them to build a stronger poker hand as you fight your way out of the King’s Well.

data.name: Burnstation
data.short_description: Deck-burning. Score-chasing. Roguelike in stile plinko. Compra cartucce retrò in un mondo cyberpunk, accumula un’enorme quantità di punti e spingi la Burnstation oltre i suoi limiti!

data.name: Void Salvage
data.short_description: Inspired by FTL and He Is Coming. A spaceship simulation with pick-from-three rewards and choice-driven encounters. Explore the void, combine and upgrade SYSTEM, then install SOCKET INSERT to build a powerful ship, all while sipping coffee or pretending to work.
data.reviews:

data.name: Wordforge: Silent Letters
data.short_description: A word-building dungeon game where every decision matters. Forge words to survive, explore dangerous halls, and awaken silent letters to gain powerful score and health bonuses. A roguelike word game where spelling is combat.

data.name: Balls & Gamble
data.short_description: Balls & Gamble is a casino-inspired incremental game where you shoot a LOT of balls, earn money, buy upgrades, gamble, unlock new balls, and eventually break reality itself.

data.name: 演义三国
data.short_description: 《演义三国》是一款有独特三国味的国风策略卡牌游戏，采用了九宫格站位，技能吟唱施法的战斗方式。在这您将要招募良将组成梦幻队伍挑战风格迥异的三国名将。
developers: 成都俊鸟科技有限公司
publishers: 成都俊鸟科技有限公司

data.name: Funeral Flowers Lament: Helena
data.short_description: A small-squad tactical RPG featuring high-speed battles and gameplay built around fast-paced combat. With the Reverse Weapon Triangle system and a 13–15 character roster, enjoy strategic battles where every ally matters. The 30-chapter story branches based on choices made in Chapter 21.

data.name: Pegs X Stickers
data.short_description: A pachinko-roguelite about scoring big numbers. Build your board, pop pegs, and discover run-breaking stickers.

data.name: Red or Black: Poker Slay
data.short_description: Red or Black, solo turn-based card battle, akin to Bang! or FaB, unique on its own. 400+ lost souls await you on your journey. With cards and your clever tactics, overcome these random foes - or "friends"? Use "Ball" to "capture" these souls, collect skills, and strengthen yourself on journey!

data.name: Gambit's Escape
data.short_description: Gambit's Escape is a strategic puzzle adventure that expands on the classic Minesweeper formula, where every move matters. Use logic to uncover the board, manage risks, and guide a king on the run as he rescues villagers and fights for his escape.

data.name: Inken
data.short_description: Explore mysterious office building suspended in a desolate world! Inken is a multi-genre roguelike that can be a deckbuilder, topdown shooter, auto runner, puzzler, or idle game! Knowledge is the power that can slay the gods!

data.name: Cosmic Crusher
data.short_description: Incremental game about protecting solar system. Destroy asteroids with a huge arsenal of weapons, upgrade your skills through a massive skill tree, and defend the solar system from hostile alien fleets. How far can you go?

data.name: Michi-Suji Puzzle: Michi Connect
data.short_description: Move blocks and search for places where the light can reach. A 3D logic puzzle where you connect a path of light from start to goal. There is no single fixed answer. If the light reaches the goal, that is your own path. Includes over 100 puzzles.

data.name: Wane’s
data.short_description: This is a Sci-fi horror point and click strategy game where you have to watch the cameras, keep eye on the animatronics, lure them away, and survive from the animatronics. You click the object you want to select.

data.name: Grit Shot
data.short_description: Miss the shot. You die. A cursed basketball roguelike where every throw is life or death.

data.name: File Tower Defence
data.short_description: Defend your desktop from invading viruses! An OS-themed strategic tower defense game where you combine various file extensions to build powerful defense towers.

data.name: BattleTabs
data.short_description: It looks like Battleship. It plays like a duel of wits. 40+ ships, each with a unique ability — build a fleet of 4 and outsmart your opponent in fast 1v1 matches. Free to play, cross-platform, 5M+ players.
data.legal_notice: © Gangbusters Ltd. All rights reserved. BattleTabs is a trademark of Gangbusters Ltd.

data.name: Dorts : A Darts Roguelike
data.short_description: First-person darts roguelike. Throw darts. Buy upgrades. Survive the chaos. Combine upgrades in unique ways to give yourself an edge and try to keep surviving as the disruptions mount and the chaos erupts!

data.name: Kingdom Contracts Tower Defense Incremental
data.short_description: The Kingdoms need you. Place just enough towers to complete Contracts. Choose perks and god spells to save gold on towers. Stack mercenary contracts rapidly; barely defending with towers, in 4 iconic regions. + your Reputation to become the Legend (in all the Kingdoms).

data.name: Eon Empires
data.short_description: Create and lead your civilization from the Stone Age to a futuristic era. Shape history on customizable maps through war, diplomacy, culture, trade, science, and religion.

data.name: Let's Cook It!
data.short_description: Scavenge for ingredients and cook them into tasty dishes with up to four players. Work together as a team to manage your restaurant and get out of debt. Build your own restaurant, unlock upgrades, and recruit NPCs!

data.name: FEED THE AI
data.short_description: Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world… or take it over?

data.name: HazardousExtractions
data.short_description: Extract and survive. Work for a secret organization as you and up to 4 friends become members of an elite squad to retrieve a sample from an underground laboratory full of secrets.

data.name: Cannon Clicker
data.short_description: Build your army from nothing to military supremacy! Cannon Clicker blends addictive idle clicker action with real strategy in a WWII setting. Expand your skill tree, juggle three currencies, and command infantry, tanks and aircraft. Crush the enemy base and dominate every battlefield!

data.name: Desktop Pinforge
data.short_description: A cyberpunk idle pinball game that lives on your desktop. Smash blocks, automate your build, upgrade your Reactor and Launcher, and let your neon machine print profit while you work or play.

data.name: Mexican Train
data.short_description: Mexican Train brings the classic game of Mexican Train Dominoes to 3D, supporting up to 7 players per online multiplayer session, or play solo and compete against up to 6 CPU players.

data.name: Amarta: Kingdom of Shadows
data.short_description: Amarta: Kingdom of Shadows is a Kingdom-like game based on the Wayang story of Babad Wanamarta, where players build a new nation and kingdom from a forbidden forest. This harmonious kingdom is ruled by the wise leaders, the Pandawa Lima.

data.name: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club
data.short_description: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, control the finances and build a winning organisation from the boardroom.

data.name: Snap the Cat
data.short_description: An incremental game about taking photos of cats. Upgrade your account, unlock new cats, and take photos of them so everyone on the planet will follow you!

data.name: Eslabong
data.short_description: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

data.name: MEGAKO☆PUNCH!
data.short_description: A Blackjack-inspired deckbuilding roguelite! Hit exactly 21 to unleash powerful Ultimate Cards! Beat your enemies to a pulp with utterly broken combos!

data.name: Black Flower
data.short_description: In this strategic roguelike survival game, knowledge is your true progression. Grow flowers, gather resources, and use clever combinations of tools, devices, charms and weather to make the Black Flower bloom.

data.name: Crownhold
data.short_description: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.

data.name: Click & Curate: Idle Photography
data.short_description: Click & Curate is a relaxing photography incremental game. Capture and collect authentic real-world photos. Curate themed galleries with high synergy to level up your studio and reach legendary prestige.

data.name: DEEP DIVER
data.short_description: Can you become the most skilled diver capable of reaching the deepest depths in the world? Every breath you take and every meter you descend will become more dangerous. Upgrade your diver with 30 different abilities and skill trees, and try to survive.

data.name: Totally Normal Meat Co.
data.short_description: Raise adorable monsters and process them into profit in this dark-humored idle management sim. Designed as a desktop companion, it runs at the bottom of your screen while you work. Optimize your production line, unlock rare species, and automate your way to a morally questionable empire.

data.name: Platon³
data.short_description: Create your deck with cubes to place them on a grid. The objective is simple : make the highest score possible. Platon³ is a roguelike and incremental game. The further you go, the higher the scores will be. But, if you lose, you have to restart and try new strategies.

data.name: Dwarven Rails
data.short_description: You are put in charge of a dwarven gun train. Your mission, destroy as many bugs as possible. Build turrets, mine ores with bullets, upgrade your train, and dare to dig deeper.

data.name: Cook with Card
data.short_description: Cook with Card is a casual cooking and restaurant management game where you prepare recipes using cards, fulfill customer orders, and upgrade your kitchen. Unlock new recipes, manage ingredients and build an efficient kitchen!

data.name: RanaRangam: Where Chess Pieces Bleed
data.short_description: RanaRangam reimagines chess as a tactical battle of health, attacks, and step-by-step commands. data.name: Dune War
data.short_description: Explore the desert. Mine rare crystals. Build your base. Survive the machine assault. Dune War features a single-player intro campaign and an endless high-score mode where every run is a fight over who control the dunes.

data.name: Valdrax Beyond the Rift
data.short_description: Build a kingdom from nothing, forge your armies, and breach the rifts between worlds. Face endless enemies, recruit legendary creatures, and prepare for the ultimate battle against the Demon Lord. Every map is different. Every death is permanent.

data.name: Scratch the Ticket
data.short_description: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

data.name: Fellwood
data.short_description: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

data.name: Smashing Bottles
data.short_description: Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

data.name: AI Apocalypse
data.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Fight the AI apocalypse with melee, magic, or rifle — 3 weapon classes, 9 build paths, 120+ cards. Every run is a new tactical puzzle of stance, distance, and deck synergy.
data.legal_notice: AI Apocalypse™ © 2026 Scuffed Studios. All rights reserved.

data.name: A Game About Flipping Cards
data.short_description: Did you read the title? That's the game, I promise. Flip cards to make money to buy upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money. There is an arbitrary goal that has been set by the developer, but you can actually play indefinitely.

data.name: Nullvein: Incremental Mining Evolution
data.short_description: Nullvein is a short, satisfying incremental mining game. Break ore blocks, find the perfect build in the skill tree, unearth the impossibly rare Firestone and craft the ultimate pickaxe. Just one more hit!

data.name: ARCWATT: Power Empire
data.short_description: Plan, power, and protect a city that runs on the grid you build. Place producers, balance demand, survive storms and surges.

data.name: Escape the Grind
data.short_description: Can you retire before 65? A financial life sim across 11 real economies with authentic salaries, housing, and investment products. A rough stretch buries you in debt. A smart run retires you at 38! And you can plug in your own real numbers too.

data.name: Garbage King
data.short_description: A short turn-based resource management and strategy roguelike where you manage a collapsing empire. Gather resources, construct buildings, manage your army, survive disasters, and keep the empire alive!

data.name: Orbit One

data.name: Silent Shark
data.short_description: A tactical, map-based WWII submarine sim set in the Pacific Theater: Approach, intercept, strike unseen, withdraw into the deep. With realistic instruments, a Torpedo Data Computer (TDC), and including a full campaign with missions, patrol zones, radio intel, and more.

data.name: Thirty Years War
data.short_description: Fight on the battlefields of early 17th-century Europe in a tactical wargame of religious war, dynastic ambition, and emerging modern armies. data.name: Fire and Movement
data.short_description: A turn-based wargame set on randomly generated hex battlefields. Read the terrain and long sightlines, scout the enemy, and coordinate tanks, infantry, and artillery to capture multiple objectives.

data.name: Sun Ultimate War
data.short_description: If you're a Tower Defense Game fan, you CANNOT miss Sun Ultimate War! Unleash ultimate plants: Watermelon Cannon, Abyss Demon, Doom Knight Mushroom. data.short_description: Amlebic is a alchemy deckbuilder. Lay elemental reagents on the great circle, chain resonance and reaction, and multiply essence by catalyst to beat the yield. Collect sigils, master the tension, and climb 200 circles to complete the Great Work.

data.name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 27
data.short_description: Recruit elite talent, build your coaching staff, develop future stars, and lead your program from opening kickoff to the national championship in the deepest college football management simulation available.

data.name: Robot In Kitchen
data.short_description: Winner of four 2026 NYX Awards. Manage a classic shop through hardcore time management and order processing. Cook global cuisines, upgrade kitchen tech like Omni pots, and unlock fully automated branches. Enjoy refined animations while building your transnational culinary empire.

data.name: Crisis Cabinet
data.short_description: Lead a nation through elections, unrest, war, scandals and economic collapse in this turn-based political strategy simulation. Spend political capital, manage budgets, survive crises and decide how far you’ll go to stay in power.

data.name: Cyber Plinko
data.short_description: Cyber Plinko is a neon roguelike deckbuilder where every run rides on the bounce. Drop balls, build your deck, and stack multipliers and rare relics, then fight back as the machine rusts, glitches and curses your board round after round.

data.name: G.O.D. Global Orbital Defense
data.short_description: Take control of the G.O.D. system, the U.P.A.’s tactical satellite. Orbiting in silence above Vel’Aris, your mission is to protect the planet from every threat. Manage orbital fire. But remember: G.O.D. sees everything... even what you wish remained buried.

data.name: Overhatched
data.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op dinosaur management game where you hatch, raise, and ship dinosaurs through increasingly hectic facilities. Order supplies, manage physical inventory, grow food, and try not to run over your friends with the forklift.

data.name: The Hidden Camp
data.short_description: The Hidden Camp is a multiplayer social deduction survival game for 9 players. Work together, complete tasks, identify the hidden traitors, and survive tense rounds filled with suspicion, strategy, and betrayal.

data.name: Roll to Ruin
data.short_description: Roll to Ruin is a medieval dice roguelite. Roll, hold, bank or farkle — Farkle rules with a deckbuilding twist. Battle through seven taverns, build your dice deck, wield 34 badges to flip the table. Outscore your rival or lose it all. Dice are fate. Every wager counts. Just one more... right?

data.name: The Legend of Mala Tokmachka
data.short_description: Build, expand, and arm a towering 2D fortress to withstand endless waves of ground and air attacks. Set in a nameless frontier village where a siege has lasted so long it became a legend, "The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" turns survival into myth.

data.name: Architects of the Universe: The Orbital Wars
data.short_description: A SNES style tactical turn based sci-fi RPG with grid based combat, about two mighty forces clashing in the skies above Earth. For fans of Mass Effect, Octopath, and classic Final Fantasy.
data.legal_notice: © NStuff Entertainment 2026

data.name: Kingdoms vs Zombies
data.short_description: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.
data.legal_notice: Kingdoms vs Zombies © MyDreamForever & Andgo Games

data.name: Dungeon Crafter
data.short_description: Build a deadly dungeon, combine monsters, traps, effects, and special items, and stop the intruder before he reaches the end. A turn-based rogue-like strategy game where you are the Dungeon Master.
data.legal_notice: © 2026 Fintasys Studio. All rights reserved.

data.name: Cyber Pinball
data.short_description: A cyber Pinball machine. An endless dark web loan. On Day 20, gather $666,666—or your brain belongs to the Titan Consortium.

data.name: Beat The Machine
data.short_description: Beat the Machine is a stock trading game, corporation simulator, and job/career simulator.

data.name: Karma Kingdom
data.short_description: A Strategy RPG game where you must rebuild a shattered world using your skill and magic. Bring land, people and equipment back from Netherspace and create a home for them. As your kingdom grows you must consider the ecology, the kingdom's happiness and acts of charity.

data.name: Simple Airline Sim
data.short_description: A minimalistic airline management game where you buy planes, choose routes and try to stay ahead of the competition.

data.name: 不心动才有鬼
data.short_description: With sudden powers, meet 6 unique girls in an extraordinary campus romance. Campus beauty, teacher, maiden, or girl next door... sweet or dangerous, all have secrets. Don't Blush is a 1st-person FMV romance where your choices shape everyone's fate. Beyond boundaries, beyond mere sparks.

data.name: Mythic Battle
data.short_description: Build your best hand in this mythology-themed auto-battler! Pick from Greek, Norse and Chinese cards and further customize your board when you upgrade your shop or combine like cards. One player comes out victorious in an 8 player free-for-all!

data.name: I CAN'T STOP WINNING!
data.short_description: A 2D blackjack inspired rogue-lite game for addicts and winners

data.name: Hardy & Molly
data.short_description: A lightweight, side-scrolling puzzle-platformer. Players use a liquefier device to alter the state of blocks while navigating platforms, ladders, and mechanisms. The goal is to dodge zombies, gather supplies, and reach the exit. Each level tests observation, timing, and route planning.

data.name: Hoop Empire
data.short_description: Draft rookies, negotiate trades, manage your cap, and create your dream franchise in this deep basketball management sim. Choose your path as a coach or an owner of one of 30 teams and build a championship dynasty one decision at a time. Customize rosters or draft classes for a unique experience.

data.name: ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator
data.short_description: Fantasy football, any time of year — no off-season, no waiting. Draft your team, outsmart your friends, play sneaky trick cards, wheel clever trades and dodge the injury curse. Experience the best fantasy Football simulator and lift the trophy.

data.name: Warrior Spirits
data.short_description: A martial arts card battler inspired by one of my favorite childhood games. Experience a story-driven adventure, level up your fighters, build your deck, shape your playstyle with stat upgrades, conquer roguelike runs, battle Raid Bosses, and fight players around the world in online pvp.
data.legal_notice: © 2025 Fabian Jueptner. All rights reserved.

data.name: Rule or Fall

data.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games

data.name: Between Adventures IDLE
data.short_description: Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources, battle creatures, and upgrade your gear. Master 10+ skills to create items you can equip or sell. Your journey never stops, even offline. No Microtransactions, No P2W, just pure idle fun.

data.name: Depth of Mind
data.short_description: In this turn-based strategy game, you must assemble the strongest team of mental operatives to overcome mental illnesses inside a person.

data.name: 深渊放置者
data.short_description: Abyss Idler is a dark fantasy-style idle RPG. Recruit multi-class heroes, collect legendary gear with rich affixes, and explore the mysterious abyss. It enables auto-adventure while idling.............

data.name: Lanternwood
data.short_description: Go on an Auto Battler Adventure with a Party of Heroes, observe them struggle, strategically build their Inventories to synergize with each other and allow them to succeed past any danger. Explore a myriad of Skills, Creatures, Events and Areas in this Auto Battling Fantasy Adventure!

data.name: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
data.short_description: Recruit your team, choose your path, and descend into hell. Four heroes must overcome the trials of the underworlds in tactical narrative encounters. A new systemic storybook experience blending mythology and surrealism. From the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.

data.name: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
data.short_description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

data.name: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation
data.short_description: Automate the arcane! Build spell-powered factories, reclaim ancient territories filled with magical secrets, and discover game-changing technology hidden across procedurally generated worlds. Master both engineering and magic in this cozy fusion of factory automation and RPG progression.

data.name: Heartfall
data.short_description: A competitive online multiplayer Hearts card game where the rules shift every hand. Match against three opponents across five rotating game modes, each one adding a twist that changes how you play, pass, and score. Currently in playtest phase.

data.name: Cyber Breaker
data.short_description: Welcome to the 'Breaker System'. Fight back against the system through a game of cards and free humanity from its systematic embrace as a BREAKER. Combine the use of skill cards and powerful artefacts alongside tactical thinking to best the system and break through the advancing array of robots.

data.name: Rogue Reigns
data.short_description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

data.name: Factory Works Idle
data.short_description: Build an industrial empire across 10 technological eras and 3 parallel dimensions. Gather resources, automate production chains, research 100 technologies, and tear through reality itself - from stone tools to singularity cores to alien dimensions with hostile ecosystems.

data.name: Plan B: Colombia Edition
data.short_description: A criminal production simulator where you build an underground empire, manage logistics, and risk everything for “white product” — including air export routes and a constant cat-and-mouse game with the law.

data.name: Mining and Dwarves
data.short_description: An incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Play actively for maximum gains, or idle and let the dwarves do the work.

data.name: ORE x TRACTOR
data.short_description: ORE x TRACTOR is a short, incremental game about demolishing space rocks with a variety of weaponry.

data.name: Fire Crew Simulator
data.short_description: Play a realistic firefighting simulator. Pilot helicopters and drive fire trucks solo, battling flames under tough weather. Refill water tanks, aim carefully, and protect cities, forests, and people while unlocking new vehicles and facing harder missions.

data.name: Monster Alchemy
data.short_description: Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.
data.legal_notice: © Team Metacarpo

data.name: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake
data.short_description: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake is a story driven tactical RPG that brings a long cherished SRPG classic back to life. Set in a vast fantasy world shaped by ancient wars, the game weaves together turn based tactical combat and character focused storytelling, where every decision carries weight.
data.legal_notice: ©USERJOY Technology Co., Ltd. All Rights Reserved.

data.name: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat.
data.short_description: Build and manage your own goblin shop. Craft unique weapons with minigames and negotiate their price! Hire workers to help you run the business! Become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

data.name: O.B.O.L
data.short_description: Play a high stake game of head or tails against a mysterious opponent, trapped under the ocean in a claustrophobic, eldritch, Lovecraftian horror atmosphere, all while slowly losing your sanity.

data.name: Powers Downtown
data.short_description: Powers Downtown is a turn-based combat RPG that features a unique fighting system. Your objective is to roam the rooftops of the city, battle enemies of varying abilities and gain experience when defeating enemies. Search for strong fighters to recruit and build a formidable team.

data.name: Fleet Hunters
data.short_description: A playful, modern take on classic grid-based naval battles. Both fleets fire at once as you hunt down your opponent’s hidden ships in fast real-time duels. Play solo, with friends, online, or over LAN or switch to turn-based Classic Mode.
data.legal_notice: Copyright © 2026 Gnarly Labs SRL. All rights reserved.

data.name: Paddle Together
data.short_description: PUSH! PUSH! PUSH! Climb sky-high waterways solo or in co-op, powered by pure pedal strength. Challenging tracks, chaos, and surprises await on your way up.

data.name: Lancers Cup
data.short_description: Manage an amateur hockey club where jobs, shifts, money, personalities, and ambitions shape every lineup. Plan practices, build detailed tactics, recruit players, and choose your own path – from playing for fun to chasing national-team tournaments.

data.name: Medieval Tax Evasion Simulator
data.short_description: Run a medieval market stall where every sale's a choice: pay your taxes like an honest merchant or evade them. Hide your untaxed wealth, train companion animals for help, and survive audits in this first-person stealth management game. Check how good you are at the fine art of looking innocent.

data.name: Bones and Coins
data.short_description: An incremental auto battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero party to slay enemies and loot items. Unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Gear up your hero team and explore new dungeon rooms filled with enemies and legendary drops.

data.name: GLUE BLOCKS
data.short_description: Glue falling blocks together to make clear massive lines! Survive wells of all shapes with dynamic gravity to a retro-inspired soundtrack. Play solo, local versus, or in hilarious online co-op in the same well with friends!

data.name: The Loopler
data.short_description: The Loopler is a roguelite deckbuilder about a slot car driving in mesmerizing loops. Pick cards, place gates, and collect charms. Settle into the loop as numbers go up and dopamine fills your brain. See how far you can go in the pursuit of infinity.

data.name: PESKY ORCS!
data.short_description: In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes: Orcs and humans. Dive into a unique mix of Autobattler, RTS and Roguelike in real retro pixelart fashion!
data.legal_notice: (c) Johannes Lott 2025/2026

data.name: Untouchable Ground
data.short_description: You are a wandering fox, caught between warring animal clans, forgotten forest gods, and a secret that can unravel the world. The forest watches. Every step, every choice, could be your last.

data.name: Undying One
data.short_description: Undying One is a tactical action RPG where every defeated enemy can be claimed for your army. Unlock new spells, raise the dead, command your forces, and endure ever-growing waves of power.

data.name: Football Survivors
data.short_description: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS BEGUN! Thousands of crazy fans are storming the field. Defend against the fans’ attack! 70+ unique heroes, professions, and abilities 50+ upgrade items 10 different classes Strategically place your heroes, manage your team, and repel the waves of fans!

data.name: Ars Mechanica
data.short_description: A strategic auto-battler RPG played on a 10×5 battlefield! Build your own mechanical army with over 300 skills and extensive customization options!
data.legal_notice: © Rufa

data.name: Protect the Pit
data.short_description: Attack with your cursor, build towers and walls to defend your pit! An incremental clicker that combines tower defense, maze building, and large upgrade trees. Earn money, upgrade your defenses, and build winding mazes to stop the hordes of the Dark Forest.

data.name: Question Roulette
data.short_description: A hardcore trivia challenge where wrong answers trigger Russian roulette.

data.name: ShoreTiles
data.short_description: Build your island around a fragile lighthouse in this Gloomy tile-placement strategy game. Balance growth, economy, and defense - because when night falls, THEY will rise from the depths.

data.name: Fuel Cell
data.short_description: Take the helm of your ship in a fully immersive VR experience. Use the periscope to detect enemies, measure their bearing and distance, then prepare your attack. Man the onboard artillery or launch torpedoes to engage hostile vessels. Each encounter rewards careful observation and precise execution.

data.name: Medieval Decklords
data.short_description: Medieval Decklords is a medieval-themed roguelike card game with a three card poker system. Outsmart opponents in duels, and upgrade your deck. Rise through the ranks to become the ultimate Decklord.

data.name: Catenoid - Wormhole Chess
data.short_description: Catenoid - Wormhole Chess is a non-Euclidean chess variant where two boards connect through a central wormhole. Pieces slide between dimensions. Pentagons block your path.

data.name: Pretty girls don't want you to die
data.short_description: "Pretty Girls Don't Want You to Die" is a strategic tower defense game with a strategy board game style. In the game, you continuously recruit pretty girl warriors, establish defensive positions by leveraging advantageous terrain, and defeat waves of enemies.

data.name: Meow with Pipeline
data.short_description: Meow with Pipeline: a precision pixel platformer with cute cats and challenges. Guide a cat through dangerous pipe networks—run, jump, dodge traps and master tough platforming. Tight controls and skill-based progression make every victory satisfyingly earned.

data.name: The Headlands
data.short_description: A meditative top-down farming strategy: the early 2000s, your home village and the machines you remember from childhood. Revive a neglected farm, trade on the market, take on neighbors' contracts and grow your fleet — from small tractors and trucks to specialized harvesters and heavy machinery.

data.name: Gold Coast Gambits: Boca Raton & Palm Beach
data.short_description: Adapted from physical board games Boca Raton & Palm Beach, this push-your-luck strategy game satisfies your need for thrilling, fast-paced game nights. data.name: Legend of Idle
data.short_description: In this incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

data.name: VANADEN
data.short_description: Vanaden is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed, fortress-like labyrinth. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and navigate shifting corridors where stealth and every decision determine your survival.

data.name: Bump Guardian
data.short_description: Bump Guardian is a deck-building defense game about protecting a growing life. Build your deck, repel incoming threats, and progress through the stages of pregnancy.

data.name: Masters of Magic
data.short_description: Chant your spells in your own voice. In Masters of Magic, you can choose to equip any spell you want and become the mage of your dreams. Each spell has 2 ways to chant, with the second chant being longer but stronger.

data.name: Pro Soccer Manager 27
data.short_description: Become the manager of a football team and take full control of your club. Manage scouting, training, facilities, and squad development. Choose your philosophy: focus on coaching and tactics, or invest in developing the next generation of stars. Success depends on your decisions.

data.name: Artillery Miner
data.short_description: An incremental mining game, where you mine through massive blocks using guns, fire, lasers and nuclear missiles. Discover new ores, unlock new worlds and weapons as you progress through the upgrades tree and become the ultimate Artillery Miner!

data.name: Plasma Dome
data.short_description: Plasma Dome is a tactical tower defense with roguelite progression and no predefined paths. Defend your city from an aerial assault of geometric entities from another dimension.

data.name: WuLin Showdown
data.short_description: A turn-based combat game with deck-building elements. Enter the world of martial arts, a realm of flashing blades and fierce contests, and duel against all manner of warriors. Every step in battle, from your own moves to the enemy's actions, is dictated by your grand strategy.

data.name: Goblins Can Conquer
data.short_description: A roguelike auto-battler where you conquer the map one tile at a time. Claim land, raise your village, and unleash spells while your goblins brawl it out. Win battles to earn new goblins and unlock powerups: strategic expansion, chaotic combat, one growing horde.

data.name: Teach Kids Math
data.short_description: Learning feels like play as children work through small math challenges at their own speed. They practice numbers, comparisons, and basic equations, then watch easy step-by-step answers that explain the idea in a way kids can follow.

data.name: CatCha
data.short_description: Discover CatCha a Roguelike and Cozy game. Play the strategic Dice Builder Roguelike, earn currencies to unlock more cats and furniture. Decorate multiple rooms in the Cat-Castle.

data.name: Flekkia
data.short_description: A Roguelite board game where every tile counts. Play as an Archer torn between the purity of the Angel and the rage of the Demon. Build your equipment, manipulate the terrain, and turn your movement into a devastating attack. Dying is only the beginning to rewrite your destiny.

data.name: Just Open The Door
data.short_description: Just Open The Door is an incremental idle game where you open doors to earn money. Buy faster workers, unlock powerful upgrades and automate the entire process as endless doors keep spawning. Simple. Satisfying. Weirdly addictive.

data.name: My Fire Is Bigger Than Yours
data.short_description: Grow a tiny fire until it's bigger than the Sun! A short incremental game about throwing things into a fire, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions.

data.short_description: An incremental horror game about loving your job a little too much. Hire workers to automate the line, then recycle them once they've stopped being useful. Your office assistant is always glad to help you climb the ladder, and to remove whoever's on it.

data.name: Cold War Battles
data.short_description: Lead Cold War formations in quick, turn based, hex‑and‑counter battles spanning 5 decades of real and hypothetical conflicts. With over 400 units, more than a dozen factions and varied theatres - from Africa to the Golan Heights, Europe and more, Cold War Battles await.

Control a region, use strategy and diplomacy, command troops, relive battles. Decisions shape history and battles forge legends.

data.name: Screen Survivors
data.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

data.name: Arc Salvo
data.short_description: Arc Salvo is a fast-paced online turn-based artillery game featuring explosive team battles, a growing arsenal, and deep character customization.

data.name: Holey Ship
data.short_description: Holey Ship is a chaotic co-op game for up to four players. Where you and your crew fix boats under pressure. Repair damage, solve fast tasks, and keep customers happy in a fun and chaotic world. Work together or mess with your friends but can your crew stop everything from sinking!

data.name: Tavrik
data.short_description: Tavrik is a hex-grid roguelite deckbuilder where every card reshapes the map. Build roads and bridges across a dangerous medieval world, then reach the exit before your energy runs out—with a friendly cat at your side.

data.name: Dread Admiral
data.short_description: Dread Admiral is a turn-based naval roguelite where every ship you lose is gone forever. Forge a floating empire, fend off the Black Fleet, and protect your Flagship through a brutal campaign to destroy the Dread Admiral himself.

data.name: Zorbo
data.short_description: Step into the ruthless world of Zorbo. Every corner is full of danger, and every enemy brings a different challenge. Improve your skills, set your strategy, and survive against smart enemies. Discover secrets, choose your weapon, and write your own legend. Are you ready?

data.name: Airport City Transport Manager
data.short_description: Tired of repetitive farm sims and basic plane games? Put your farm on hold. Start building a tiny town and transform it into a massive megapolis with a world-class modern airport! We constantly update the game to ensure you are always engaged—both on the ground and in the air.

data.name: The Undercut: Racing Manager
data.short_description: Circuits come and go. Sponsors rise and fall. Every season reshuffles the deck. A retro motorsport management sim with physics-driven races, procedurally generated tracks, and a dynamic world that never plays the same way twice.

data.name: Chronicles Puzzle: History Path
data.short_description: Piece together the shards of time in this historical sliding puzzle game. Experience a journey from the Big Bang to the future through 80 unique levels and 320 challenges. Choose from four difficulties, collect trophies, and unlock the wonders of the world - available in 14 languages.

data.name: The Singularity
data.short_description: Face your friends in a futuristic/cyberpunk card game where each card unleashes a different kind of chaos. Manage to keep the Singularity in your hand until the end to be the winner. Establish the Singularity at the end of the game and disconnect your opponents. Are you ready?

data.name: Undying Flame
data.short_description: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

data.name: Alice's Gaze
data.short_description: "Alice's Gaze" is a dark fairy-tale clicker and idle game. Accompany Alice as she awakens in a strange mansion, gaze upon the cat god's altar, delve into the abyss of terror, revive the slumbering rooms one by one, and search for a way to escape.

data.name: Next Reign: Kingdom
data.short_description: Transform a tiny settlement into a thriving medieval kingdom in this incremental strategy game. Build your economy, command your army, and keep discovering new ways to grow with every milestone.

data.name: Business Defence
data.short_description: A forced perspective, business themed tower defence game where the player deploys corporate towers to hold back waves of protestors. Demolish special towers to adjust enemy stats and affect the score multiplier. Play through the story to find out if BBB learns anything along the way.

data.name: The Pay Window: 80s Wrestling Simulator
data.short_description: Book shows, manage talent, build feuds, and survive the US territory era and beyond in a text-based wrestling booking sim where ratings, money, morale, and momentum can make or break your promotion.

data.name: Tower Realm
data.short_description: Tower Realm is a high-strategy Magic Tower RPG collection with fixed maps and stats, auto turn-based battles, and precise resource-route planning. Clear hardcore with no supplies, or use the Green Key to lower difficulty. Earn clear points to unlock custom challenges.

data.name: Journey
data.short_description: Keita, a brave emperor penguin, lost its way during the migration and would start an extraordinary adventure on the ice alone.

data.name: Decorate! hololive Sticker Battle
data.short_description: "Decorate! hololive Sticker Battle" is a PvP auto-battler where you decorate your favorite Holomem with stickers and battle against other players.

data.name: Friend and foe
data.short_description: Friends to your face, foes to your scoreboard. A sci-fi deckbuilding roguelike where you cooperate to survive the onslaught, then sabotage your friends to stay on top. Play solo, with bots, or team up online

data.name: mhas dungeon sweeper
data.short_description: Explore the dungeon in this roguelike twist on Minesweeper, where monsters replace mines. Defeat increasingly powerful enemies to vanquish the Reaper. Read the situation. Watch their behavior. Use your items wisely.

data.name: Pibcremental
data.short_description: A cozy, chaotic idle-incremental clicker about growing a civilisation of tiny creatures called Pibbles in a giant tree, set in a post-human world.

data.name: Push and Pull
data.short_description: The Push and Pull is a couch co-op only puzzle platformer about playing as two dualistic bunnies looking for a home.

data.name: Runisthar
data.short_description: Master the Power of Runes in a tactical and highly modular roguelike. Use elements, create lethal synergies, and annihilate your opponents. Offense is the only rule.

data.name: Kingdom Klicker
data.short_description: Kingdom Klicker is an idle clicker game you found on an old 80s computer that allows you to build, upgrade and organize a kingdom, but as you play it becomes more and more clear that something lurks beneath the surface, trying to get out...

data.name: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
data.short_description: Dice Tavern combines the classic dice game Farkle with roguelike deckbuilding. Every roll is filled with risk and opportunity. Manipulate the odds, activate powerful synergies, and build your own scoring engine as you rise from a small village tavern to the very top of the throne.

data.name: Just Keep Fishing
data.short_description: A short incremental game about catching a lot of fish.

data.name: Who Haunts The Haunters?
data.short_description: Who Haunts The Haunters? is an East Asian-inspired social deduction game. Purify the mansion as a Ghost, or corrupt it as an Intruder and unleash the Ahgwi Night Hunt. Follow strange sounds, flickering candles, distorted shadows, and suspicious traces to uncover the truth.

data.name: A Game About Creating The Universe
data.short_description: An idler game where you get to build up the universe from scratch. You are a part of an advanced space civilization that builds universes.

data.name: Math-Havoc
data.short_description: Solve fast. Think faster. Math-Havoc is a rapid-fire logic game where every second counts. Chain correct answers, push your limits, and survive as long as you can.

data.name: ScaMMO
data.short_description: Incremental game where you play as a frustrated rich MMO veteran promising to make the next WoW killer. How far will you get before cashing out?

data.name: Chicken Miner
data.short_description: Capture chickens and bring them to the mine! The captured chickens will mine minerals on behalf of the player. The higher-level hunting grounds you visit, the rarer chickens you can encounter!

data.name: Pengzle:Arctic Arcane
data.short_description: Pengzle is a real-time puzzle action adventure where you weave mana into spell formulas in the middle of battle. Read the flow of combat, build the right combination, and cast at the perfect moment as a small penguin mage in a distinctive polar fantasy world.

data.name: Disconnected
data.short_description: Astronauts lost in space search for an alien planet to accept them and give them a home. The astronauts have lost the ability to make decisions and a sense of who they are. Your job is to help them find themselves again, so they stand the best chance when meeting aliens.

data.name: Fortress Merge
data.short_description: Merge buildings, upgrade your defenses, and protect your fortress from endless waves of zombies. Plan each move carefully, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

data.name: SeaColony
data.short_description: SeaColony is a survival colony-builder set on the open sea. Build and expand a floating colony, manage colonists, research technologies, and develop farming, fishing, production, and power systems. Trade with merchant ships and survive pirate raids, fires, and harsh weather as your colony grows.

data.name: EQUILIBRIUM
data.short_description: Govern by typing: cut taxes, nationalize energy, declare a state of emergency. Every order becomes real economic and political consequences. How long can you keep the EQUILIBRIUM?

data.name: Discremental
data.short_description: Discremental is a short idle and incremental game where you primarily upgrade your disk, along with other equipment.

data.name: Crow's Foot
data.short_description: A turn-based hex strategy you can finish over lunch. Outsmart AI rivals, each with their own grudges, ambitions, and breaking points. Conquer provinces, command knights, scouts, assassins, and more. Unlock rule-bending scrolls. Go bankrupt and your own army defects.

data.name: Trailkeeper
data.short_description: Trailkeeper is a hand-authored collection of four classic logic puzzles — Slitherlink, Masyu, Yajilin, and Hashi — set to the rhythm of a quiet woodland trail. Solve at your own pace, return for a new daily trail, and trace your way through every grid in the bank.

data.name: Loop Miner
data.short_description: Loop Miner is a mining incremental game where a cute mole miner endlessly digs through mines, gathers resources, collects artifacts, and ventures deeper underground. Experience the satisfaction of growing stronger through endless mining loops.

data.name: RITUAL
data.short_description: RITUAL is a cyber-occult action roguelite where you survive escalating waves, forge devastating builds through sci-fi weapons, rhythm-breaking tech, and reality-altering Fonts, and battle five bosses inside the Martian terradome of TRA-3.

data.name: PNR: Point of No return
data.short_description: Don't dodge. Break through. PNR: Point of No Return is a space opera roguelite where you charge into a storm of enemy fire, intercepting every shot while assembling a different build each sortie. Unlock battleships, equip devastating weapons, and wipe out the enemy fleet. Do you have what it takes?

data.name: 风之国世界
data.short_description: This game is a fantasy style cultivation+MMORPG game, focusing on character development, pet matching, and guild territory confrontation. Players use forging and upgrading as the core growth line to participate in guild territory wars and win the title of king.

data.name: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
data.short_description: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

data.name: Great Northern War
data.short_description: Fight for mastery of the Baltic in a tactical wargame of aggressive Swedish assaults, Russian military reform, winter campaigns, and shifting alliances. data.name: King in the Mountain

data.short_description: A dark, text-and-pixel monster-breeding sim. Hatch abominations, train them with a TRPG card hand, and send them off to the surface for good. Stats and Traits inherit down two separate bloodlines, so every generation is a deliberate choice, not a reroll.

data.name: Monban: Spirit Gate

data.name: Relaxation Massage Studio
data.short_description: Relaxation Massage Studio is a relaxing massage studio management sim. Use the character customization system with over a thousand appearance options and hundreds of presets to create customers. As your studio grows, you’ll unlock new interactions and shape your dream massage studio.

data.name: Algorithms
data.short_description: Practice computer science algorithms offline, for job interviews or personal skill building: read a problem, write C, run the full test deck, and get a deterministic verdict with instruction counts and the output assembly language code on a fantasy RISC machine.

data.name: Celestial Empire
data.short_description: Forge an empire under the watchful eyes of the gods! Take care of your people, develop efficient production chains and trade with other landlords. Ensure their survival through harsh winters and disasters.

data.name: Solar Expanse - Space Exploration Manager
data.short_description: Explore the Solar System. Mine and drop asteroids. Colonize and terraform. Lead the space race and compete with other corporations on your way to profit. Watch the expansion of human race over the centuries.

data.name: Celestial Empire: Prologue
data.short_description: Embrace your duties as a new provincial governor. Experience the beauty of ancient China, design the city of your dreams, and take care of your people’s needs. Earn the Gods’ favor to maintain the Mandate of Heaven for the ruling dynasty.

data.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction
data.short_description: A turn-based sci-fi strategy that combines exploration and exciting clashes on the battlefield. Take control over several different species, raise powerful armies for your heroes and destroy your opponents! This HoMM-like is set in a scifi universe, with new mechanics on top of the classic formula.

data.name: Planet Coaster 2: Silver Screen Pack
data.short_description: Craft spectacular movie sets and cinematic backdrops to bring your silver screen adventures to life. Create the metropolis of your dreams with striking skyscrapers, rich gold detailing, and sleek stucco finishes.

data.name: Nucleares - AO Extra Power Pack
data.short_description: More intelligence. More power. Same battery. AO has never been better… according to Nucleares.

data.name: Dagger Directive
data.short_description: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.
