data.name: Tactical Annihilation
data.short_description: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!

data.name: Kingdoms Test Of Time
data.short_description: A retro kingdom builder from ancient times to the future, with war, trade, revolutions, sports, and custom maps.

data.name: Three Kingdoms: Shu-Han Chronicles
data.short_description: This is a turn-based role-playing game that tells the story of Liu Bei from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the unification of the world. Over 60+ unique famous generals can be collected, and dozens of classic books can be combined to build the strongest team in your heart

data.name: Automon Arena
data.short_description: Capture creatures with trash bags and scrap your way to the top! Automon Arena is a fast auto-battler where you bag wild animals and fight other kids until only one survives!

data.name: Excremental Game
data.short_description: You're a little poop flushed away on a revenge mission to cover the world in poop! A chaotic incremental Poop-Shooter where bouncing poop earns points! Level up your poop, and unleash explosive, multi-poop madness!
data.legal_notice: ©Hooded Traveler Games, all rights reserved.

data.name: Fractured Universe
data.short_description: A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development. Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed. Featured various art styles and aesthetics.

data.name: This Is Golf
data.short_description: This Is Golf is a casual but challenging first-person golf game with randomly generated holes. Shot shaping and distance are based entirely on mouse motion. Play solo or in lobbies of up to 8 players, and enjoy a fun, competitive, and slightly goofy golfing experience.

data.name: Megaris
data.short_description: A casual classic puzzle game with lots of modes and extras.

data.name: Empire Eleven 2026
data.short_description: Build your football empire. Scout talent, manage finances, develop tactics and lead your club from obscurity to glory in a deep football management simulation.

data.name: SFTP - Super Football Tactics Pro
data.short_description: Super Football Tactics Pro drops you into the high-energy chaos of a wild football league where classic checkers meets hard-hitting strategy. Plan your moves, outsmart your opponent, and unleash game-changing special powers that can flip the match in an instant.

data.name: Snuggle Nightmare
data.short_description: Survive this first-person mascot horror adventure set in an abandoned theme park. Solve puzzles, craft tools, avoid a deadly animatronic, and uncover the secrets hidden within Brain World Rots.

data.name: Throne of Cards
data.short_description: Build a kingdom from a handful of cards. Stack and combine cards to gather resources, train soldiers, unlock powerful decks, and forge a strategy around rulers, artifacts, and survival.

data.name: Reborn Arena
data.short_description: Reborn Arena is a fast 2D pixel-art wizard duel for 1v1 and 2v2. Win the round and you rewrite the rules for everyone next round. Lose it and you get permanently stronger. Draft elemental cards, stack a build no two matches repeat, and find out who's really winning by the final point.

data.name: 《美少女旅馆：可爱即是正义，但正义需要处刑》
data.short_description: 一间神秘的旅馆，一群彼此怀疑的美少女，一场无法停止的猎杀游戏。在谎言与处刑之间，找出真正的狼人，每一个选择，都会改写她们的结局。

data.name: Goaldeck
data.short_description: Football meets roguelike deck-building. Be the coach: draft legends, stack Manager Cards, and manage player egos with Reigns-style choices. Place your squad across 3 zones, open packs, upgrade cards, and conquer all 8 cups against escalating AI. Lose and start over — win and lift the trophy.

data.name: 100 for Justice
data.short_description: A text-driven political roguelite and life-management sim about building resistance across up to 100 lives. Choose a profession, survive monthly pressure, carry permanent legacies forward, oppose oppressive laws, organize aid, and return a fictional country to its people.

data.name: Arms Dealer
data.short_description: Build a black-market empire from debt to unimaginable wealth in this deep strategy trading simulation. Buy weapons, manage risk, evade authorities, and profit from global conflict.
data.legal_notice: © 2026 Koro Pixel. All rights reserved. Unauthorized use, reproduction, or distribution is prohibited. This product includes licensed audio, visual, and software components.

data.name: Idle Polygon
data.short_description: Expand your territory and watch your numbers soar in Idle Polygon, a minimalist incremental game with RPG depth. Upgrade your Geoms, optimize production to astronomical levels, and test your strength in strategic battles. Experience a mesmerizing world where math and growth collide.

data.name: Land and Castles: Gold
data.short_description: A retro real time strategy game with solo and multiplayer. Build your own maps and play online with friends.

data.name: Null and Void
data.short_description: Null and Void is a darkly satirical deckbuilding tower defence where even death doesn't free you from debt - your clone just inherits the bill. Only mining pays enough to survive and that means destroying entire worlds, but hey, there are always more planets.

data.name: Crown&Sword
data.short_description: Crown & Sword is an epic 2D tactical Action RPG that combines base management, army building, and wave survival elements. You must manage your time in a dynamic day/night cycle, fortify your kingdom, and fight shoulder to shoulder against the relentless swarms that awaken when the sun sets.

data.name: Gods Shall Tremble
data.short_description: Gods Shall Tremble is a deep, text-based gladiator management sim. Program granular fight plans, balance 16 stats, 39.5 Million Behavioural Combinations and loot 15 Million unique items to compete in multiple PvE modes, PvP leaderboards, and friendly and permadeath tournaments to cement your legacy.

data.name: HexLight
data.short_description: A deterministic abstract tactics game of geometric armies, color conversion, factory warfare, the Central Prism, and board-changing Light Storms—solo, in puzzles, or online.
data.legal_notice: © 2026 Cameron Olson. All rights reserved. HexLight™ and the HexLight logo are trademarks of Cameron Olson.

data.name: Unbroken Valor
data.short_description: In this dark ink‑wash roguelike card game, build your 3‑person squad. Freely combine Eight‑Gua elements, 12 Blessings, treasures, talismans and mental insights. Fight and grow within endless time loops; every sword swing is a new unknown adventure.

data.name: Guardian of soul tower
data.short_description: Fight in real-time, build powerful elemental decks, and climb the Soul Tower in this dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Every death leaves behind a Nemesis Phantom created from your own deck, waiting to challenge you in future runs.

data.name: The Witch's Game:Wheel of Fortune
data.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game built on Texas Hold'em hand rankings. Answer the call to another world and duel eight witches with your soul points at stake. Manage your hand, time your spells, and outsmart your opponents in a blend of luck and strategy. Short rounds, pick up and play anytime.

data.name: Homunculus: The Little One in the Flask
data.short_description: Create a digital Homunculus with a unique personality, history, lifespan, and grand ambition. Guide its journey through limited divine oracles, watch it make choices of its own, meet other characters, build or lose its loyalty, and preserve its evolving story in diaries and memories.

data.name: F2 A! Idle Army
data.short_description: F2A! Idle Army is an idle strategy game. Recruit & upgrade your army – auto-battle crushes endless foes. No micro, no stress – watch your legion sweep the field. With 100+ tech & hero upgrades, grow forces, unlock combos, and rise from weak to unstoppable.

data.name: Neko Rogue
data.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder set in a dystopian neon city. Build a deck, sabotage enemy Intent Cards, steal block and cut damage, then loot defeated foes’ cards for the next fight. Outplay unique enemy decks, climb hostile districts, and conquer the underworld—one hand at a time.

data.name: Political Survival - Head of State
data.short_description: Lead your nation through political decisions, balance happiness, economy, military, technology, and environment, compete against rival states, and respond to global events in this turn-based political strategy simulation where every choice shapes your country's future.

data.name: Corners Arena
data.short_description: Lead a squad of 3D sentinels across a living strategy board. Step, build long jump chains, and occupy the rival corner first in local two-player matches or against an easy or tactical computer opponent.

data.name: Minenumbing
data.short_description: MineNumbing is a hand-drawn tower defense game where players build powerful turrets using bombs and fight alongside them with a magical pencil. Combine strategy, resource management, and fast-paced combat to survive increasingly challenging enemy waves.

data.name: Sleep Aid
data.short_description: Not every game is meant to be fair. Not every player is meant to survive. Bluff, adapt, and outsmart your opponent in tense poker matches where the cards don't always play by the rules.

data.name: Battle Of Plans
data.short_description: Weekly Clan Wars are live! Join your clan, climb the bracket, and battle for epic rewards. Collect mythic heroes and build your ultimate army today!
data.legal_notice: © 2026 Battle Of Plans. All rights reserved.

data.name: Idle Abyss Miner
data.short_description: A relaxing idle incremental game featuring automated mining, miner synergy builds, and abyss exploration. Recruit unique miners, unlock special bonuses, build your automated mining line, and defeat abyssal guardians for rare ores!

data.name: Dr. Bowlatzo's Crazy Bowling
data.short_description: A quick-play roguelike bowling game. Get strikes, get achievements, get high scores. Try different ball combos for different gameplay strategies. See if you can defeat Dr. Bowlatzo!
data.legal_notice: Sourdough Games LLC © 2026.

data.name: Platform Nation
data.short_description: Build a sovereign nation on an empty ocean platform. Manage citizens, resources, trade, diplomacy, propaganda, philanthropy, and war in a satirical strategy game where every choice helps train the artificial intelligence that will judge your civilization.

data.name: Barrel Chess
data.short_description: Four chessboards. One barrel. Every "safe" square you know is a lie here. Chess just lost its edges, and so did your confidence. Four boards fused into one barrel. Same rules, no walls, nowhere to trap a king. Face BarrelBot, running real Stockfish Engine across all 4 boards.

data.name: Governor
data.short_description: An economic strategy game where you run the central bank. Built on the IS–PC–MR macroeconomic model. The policy rate, unemployment, inflation, the trade balance. Can you keep the economy clear of overheating and slumps?

data.name: A Dragon's Tale
data.short_description: An exciting reverse Tower Defense! Defend the tower from hordes of civilians, strategically place your monsters, and take on the challenge across 3 unique modes: Story, Hardcore, and Infinity.

data.name: Magic Chess
data.short_description: Magic Chess, inspired by Chess and Chinese Chess, breaks free from traditional boundaries by introducing brand-new pieces and items, resulting in over 1,000,000 possible combinations. The game supports Single Player, Custom Matches, Local Multiplayer, and Online Random Matchmaking.

data.name: AfterImage
data.short_description: A puzzle platformer where every attempt you record replays as a solid, physical actor - and the way up is built out of them. Leave an echo of your run and stand on it. Build levels in the same physics and publish them; the server re-simulates your clear before anyone else can play it.

data.name: The Memory Library
data.short_description: Found the card you need? Then combine it. Even a card that looks completely useless might become surprisingly useful once you combine it. Probably. Collect and synthesize cards, create unexpected synergies, and take on 10 story chapters and an endless dungeon.

data.name: Watt the Bounce! — A Momentum Power Lab
data.short_description: Turn bouncing balls into power in a physics-driven incremental sandbox. Unlock unusual balls, build automated machines, and combine acceleration pads, portals, black holes, cats, frogs, and launch wells into chaotic production chains. Expand your laboratory and power the entire world.

data.name: A Couple Nights At The Chud House
data.short_description: You fell asleep first at the sleepover, and now your friends aren't acting quite the same. Defend yourself from the Chuds in this point-and-click style horror game, uncover forgotten memories, and discover what's really happening.

data.name: Dice Chemist
data.short_description: A dice-poker roguelike where lucky rolls become alchemical combos. Roll, hold, and chain catalyst synergies to clear twelve rounds — and beyond.

data.name: EndlessRain
data.short_description: A 4-player co-op survival defense roguelite. By day, gather resources and build your base. By night, hold the line against endless waves. Gunners cannot build. Engineers cannot shoot. Survive all 30 nights together, or fall apart alone.

data.name: 鬼牢關
data.short_description: 在《鬼牢關》這片流放之地收集符咒與令牌，打造屬於你專屬的牌組！探索行區，結識夥伴一同冒險。

data.name: Deck & Conn
data.short_description: Take command of a nuclear-powered space corvette in a Cold War-flavored sci-fi campaign. Balance tactics, crew, and limited resources in a dynamic forever-war. Retro pixel art meets deep strategy fifteen minutes into the future of 1989.

data.name: Car Park Capital
data.short_description: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

data.name: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future
data.short_description: Follow the dreams of humanity's boldest pioneers in Surviving Mars: Relaunched "Feeding the Future". Master the art of feeding a colony and face the challenges of life on Mars. Contains new buildings, food resources, colonist traits, technologies, and laws.

data.name: WARNO - Nemesis #8 - School’s Out!
data.short_description: Mobilize two Instructor-filled divisions in Nemesis - School’s Out!, bringing a host of new training and academy units, vehicles, and weapons. The tank-heavy West German Verfügungstruppenkommando 42 goes head-to-head against the experienced Soviet 71-ya Zapasnaya Tankovaya Diviziya.
data.legal_notice: Developed and published by Eugen Systems.

data.name: Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe
data.short_description: Expand your wildlife preserve with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe! Discover 25 bird cards, grow your collection, and unlock a unique player portrait.

data.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana – The Hippodrome
data.short_description: Build the Hippodrome, host chariot races, and grow your splendor! Your citizens are crying out for more spectacle, and your specialists stand ready to prove themselves on the racetrack.

data.name: Cataclismo - Supporter Pack
data.short_description: The Cataclismo Supporter Pack features the official game soundtrack, along with 4K wallpapers and a detailed look at the game’s delicately crafted world and characters in a 200+ page digital artbook.
